name: uranium_prereg_v1_A1_run
caveat: SYNTHETIC column, not Oklo or the Franceville Basin; uranium prereg v1+A1
statement: Verification of the declared synthetic equations of uranium pre-registration v1 with Amendment A1, to the tested tolerances. It does not validate the assumed rates, sorption values or organic zone, and it is not a reconstruction of Oklo or the Franceville Basin. Every check below was run; no continuous integration ran.
output_sampling: breakthrough and ledger at every 0.05 tau landing point from t = 0 (101 points); C and S profiles at the six output times
